Subject: Streamline Insights — COI, vendor questionnaire, and PO setup

Hi Alicia,

Great to meet you on the call yesterday — thanks for the walkthrough of the integration plan. Procurement has requested two items to move the PO and onboarding forward:

1) A current Certificate of Insurance (COI) listing Redwood Inference (Redwood Inference, Inc.) as the additional insured with the policy period clearly visible.
2) The completed vendor risk questionnaire we shared (I attached the editable spreadsheet to this thread for convenience).

If you can provide the COI and the completed questionnaire by EOD Thursday (Feb 12), we can route the PO to Finance the following morning. Also confirm the remit address and W-9 will come from the same billing contact.

Quick note for your team: Procurement sometimes requests an endorsement naming Redwood as an additional insured for General Liability and Cyber when vendors process data. If your broker needs Redwood's legal address, use: 2400 Mission St, San Francisco, CA 94110.

Thanks — looping Karthik for any questions about required fields on the questionnaire.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com | (415) 555-0193

Hi Hannah — thanks for the summary.

Quick answers: we can provide a COI and the completed questionnaire. Our broker is pulling an updated COI now; ETA is tomorrow morning (Feb 12). I filled the questionnaire with the answers I could and attached it — there are two items where I need clarification (see rows highlighted in yellow):

- Q23: Data retention window — our platform retains logs for 180 days by default; we can scope to 90 days for Redwood if required.
- Q35: Subprocessor list — we use CloudGrid (cloudgrid.io) and LogFlow (logflow.ai) as subprocessors; we can provide contracts if needed.

Also attaching a draft W-9 and our billing contact details. If the PO needs special invoice language, let me know.

Best,
Alicia Gomez
Head of Finance Operations | Streamline Insights
alicia.gomez@streamlineinsights.com | +1 212-555-0228

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:29:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Streamline Insights — COI, vendor questionnaire, and PO setup

Looping in Marissa and Finance.

Alicia — thanks for the quick turnaround. Two clarifications from our side before we route PO to Finance:

- COI: the additional insured endorsement needs to include General Liability (GL) and Professional Liability (if available). The COI draft you attached lists GL but the endorsement page is missing. If the broker can provide the endorsement or a certificate showing additional insured on GL, that's sufficient for initial PO issuance.

- Data retention: 180 days is acceptable for initial engagement, but please flag any endpoints that retain raw customer data beyond session logs. We will want an explicit line in the SOW or contract if retention >90 days for production data.

Marissa — once Alicia confirms the endorsement and we have the questionnaire with the two clarifications addressed, can you handle routing the PO to Finance and confirm expected invoice terms (Net30/Net45)?

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Legal Ops | Redwood Inference
